items.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
items.body: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

items.title: Ethereum Gets Another Privacy Boost as Aztec Brings Back zk.money
items.body: Aztec Labs relaunched its self-custodial zk.money wallet on Aztec Network, letting users make private stablecoin payments using readable tags.

items.title: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia for Oct. 6
items.body: Glamsterdam will bring proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and new gas pricing, while its mainnet date remains unset.

items.title: BitMine could hit its 5% Ether supply target within weeks — then what?
items.body: BitMine could reach 5% of Ether’s supply by early November, while Tom Lee has left open whether it would continue buying beyond that level.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin says Hegotá could be Ethereum’s last ‘normal’ fork
items.body: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin said PeerDAS marked the start of Ethereum’s transition “from being just a blockchain to being something much more powerful.”

items.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
items.body: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.
